figurative_meaning_en: all together, roughly or in gross terms
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই প্রকল্পের খরচ মোটমাট পাঁচ লাখ টাকা।
example_sentences_in_english: Roughly ten people came to the party.
The cost of this project is about five lakh rupees in total.
note: This idiom is commonly used in spoken Bengali for quick approximations without precise details.
